definition: the habit of speech that makes my sentences read flatter than my confidence is

settled:
I was a maths major and I speak the way a proof reads. Minimal words, structure carrying the precision, no qualifier that adds no content.

A hedge that adds no information feels like noise, so I leave it out.

A claim out of a conceptual model rather than a felt sense is crisp by construction. There is no felt fuzz to soften it.
